""""
Automation of the manual transposition from columns K:V.

The source block occupies columns A:J (one record per row, starting at row 2).
The transposed block goes into K2:V10 (first transposed row already done by
hand as an example - we reproduce/complete the remaining ones).

Only cell *values* are written; existing formatting is left untouched.
"""

import openpyxl

INPUT_FILE = "input.xlsx"
OUTPUT_FILE = "output.xlsx"

SOURCE_SHEET = "Sheet1"
SOURCE_FIRST_COL = 1            # column A
SOURCE_LAST_COL = 10            # column J
SOURCE_FIRST_ROW = 2            # data starts under the header

TARGET_FIRST_COL = 11           # column K
TARGET_LAST_COL = 22            # column V
TARGET_FIRST_ROW = 2            # transposed block starts here

# Load workbook keeping formatting intact
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_FILE)
ws = wb[SOURCE_SHEET]

# Find the last used row in the source block (handles ~2000 rows dynamically)
last_source_row = SOURCE_FIRST_ROW
for r in range(SOURCE_FIRST_ROW, ws.max_row + 1):
    if any(ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value not in (None, "")
           for c in range(SOURCE_FIRST_COL, SOURCE_LAST_COL + 1)):
        last_source_row = r

# Collect source values
source_data = []
for r in range(SOURCE_FIRST_ROW, last_source_row + 1):
    row_vals = [ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value
                for c in range(SOURCE_FIRST_COL, SOURCE_LAST_COL + 1)]
    source_data.append(row_vals)

# Transpose: column i of the source becomes row i of the target block.
# Position correspondence: target row r (2..) <- source column r
#                          target column c (K..) <- source row c-1 offset
for i, col_vals in enumerate(zip(*source_data)):
    target_row = TARGET_FIRST_ROW + i
    for j, val in enumerate(col_vals):
        target_col = TARGET_FIRST_COL + j
        if target_col > TARGET_LAST_COL:
            break
        ws.cell(row=target_row, column=target_col).value = val

wb.save(OUTPUT_FILE)
print(f"Transposed {len(source_data)} source rows into columns K:V of "
      f"'{SOURCE_SHEET}' and saved as '{OUTPUT_FILE}'.")"
